scenario: A streaming-market brief covers only independent animation studios that survive five years and generate more than $20M in annual streaming revenue. Executives use the brief's average to estimate typical studio revenue.

data.description: Only surviving studios with revenue above $20M are included. Revenue is Normal with sigma $6M.

question: Estimate (a) the true mean revenue mu across all studios and (b) the fraction of studios included in the brief.
naive_answer: Typical studio revenue is about $22.7M because that is the brief average.
naive_trap: The brief includes only upper-tail surviving studios.
reasoning_trace: Use the lower-truncated normal model with alpha around 1.4.
python_verification:
from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm
def eq(mu): a=(20-mu)/6; return mu+6*norm.pdf(a)/norm.sf(a)-22.72
mu=brentq(eq,-50,19.99)
frac=norm.sf((20-mu)/6)
assert abs(mu-11.6)<0.6 and abs(frac-0.0808)<0.005
